svg.title: Measuring speeds: the Junction quake out to 300 km
svg.desc: Record section of the M3.3 quake near Junction, Utah: the vertical seismograms of 24 University of Utah stations from 29 to 299 km (distance down the page) against seconds after the quake (0 to 70, across). Filled dots are the analysts' picks (P at 15 stations, S at 3); open circles are computer picks. A blue line fitted to the analysts' P picks within 100 km has a speed of 6.1 km/s; a slope triangle on it reads 100 km in 16.3 s. A red line fitted to all S picks out to 240 km has a speed of 3.7 km/s; a dotted red line through the three analyst S picks has 3.4 km/s. Beyond about 250 km the P arrivals come before the blue line.
svg.text: Measuring speeds: the Junction quake out to 300 km
far away, P arrives before the line
